$comment: Where clean plates are kept. Its count IS its block (0..capacity), so each rack keeps its own; a layout's rack starts with `start` plates. More plates means more racks.
label: Plate rack

words.free: Plate rack - {n} plate{s}. Press to take one; press holding a clean plate to put it back
words.empty: Plate rack - empty. Wash plates at the sink and put them back
words.full: Plate rack - full ({n} plates). Press to take one
